title: Merge Nodes with Bottom Pointers
problemStatement: You are given two sorted linked lists where each node is connected using bottom pointers instead of next pointers. Merge the two lists into a single sorted list using only the bottom pointers. Return the head of the merged list.
input: Two linked lists connected using bottom pointers.
output: The head of the merged linked list.
constraints: Total number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
